**Finding submitted: T4C — missing (confidence 0.86)**

- **Investigation:** Section 8.1 sets a three-year term. Section 9 contains only for-cause (9.1), insolvency (9.2), Vendor-failure (9.3) and cross-Order-Form (9.5) mechanics. Sections 6.2, 19.4, 20.5, 10.2 and 27.3 are all cause- or event-triggered exits. Searches for "convenience", "without cause", and "early termination fee" returned nothing operative. Section 8.2's 180-day non-renewal notice is natural-term non-renewal (RENEWAL rule), so it was deliberately not double-flagged as a Vendor convenience right.
- **Classification:** No Customer convenience right in a multi-year term = walk-away territory, so a redline was required rather than a rationale note.
- **Cure:** One insert (new 9.4) at the preferred level carrying exactly the four preferred elements — Agreement-or-Order-Form scope, 30 days' written notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term. I used lowercase "prepaid fees" rather than the narrower defined "Fees" (which excludes implementation charges), omitted "in whole or in part" as not required by this Order Form structure, and added no survival, expense, or procedural tails.
